pregnancy.quote: Risk Summary Data from a large population-based cohort study, as well as other published studies over several decades, have not identified a drug-associated risk of major birth defects with the use of interferon beta products during early pregnancy.

lactation.quote: Risk Summary Limited published literature has described the presence of interferon beta-1a products in human milk at low levels.
